newsitem.title: USA: Del. economic activity index rises 0.4 pct in Feb..
newsitem.headline: Del. economic activity index rises 0.4 pct in Feb..

text.p: Delaware's economic activity index rose 0.4 percent in February, the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said Wednesday.
Increases in payroll employment and hours worked and a decline in the unemployment rate all contributed to the rise.
Delaware's index increased 2.2 percent for the 12 months ending in February, the bank said.
The national Index of Coincident Indicators compiled by the Conference Board rose 0.4 percent in February and was up 3.3 percent over the last 12 months.
The Economic Activity Index for Delaware is constructed from three monthly data series -- payroll employment, average hours worked in manufacturing, and the unemployment rate.
